assertions: He will purchase Master B.'s houses and the purchase will be completed, not fall through
He should deal with the seller: the seller will come to agreement rather than refuse him or sell to another in the end
The money for the purchase will be procured in time to pay when payment falls due, despite the present block on calling his own money in
Completion will be with delay and labour over a scale of months, not quickly or smoothly: negotiation and getting the money in will cause repeated difficulty and anxiety before perfection
The seller's first demand of £530 will not stand as stated: the seller, initially proud and high in his demands, will soften and abate his terms

The houses themselves are sound and the title/substance is not fatally defective: Saturn, lord of the 4th, has no material debility apart from retrogradation and cadency, which signify delay rather than ruin
method: Classical horary astrology after Lilly, Christian Astrology Book II (whole-house significators: querent, lord of 7th seller, lord of 4th houses, lord of 2nd money)
reasoning: 本题应验跨度定为月档，依据为钱须等其自有款项到期、卖价须议定的购房进程，非日级近事。Seller's significator Sun placed in the 7th and received by Venus in exaltation near the cusp of the 7th shows the seller receptive beneath proud demands; lord of the 7th being also lord of the 11th makes the seller the instrument of the querent's hopes. Venus applying to a trine of Saturn, lord of the 4th, is perfection between seller-side and the houses themselves. The Moon translating light by a square out of signs of long ascension is mitigated, a square there operating like a friendly aspect, so perfection comes but through difficulty. Mercury, lord of the 2nd, retrograde explains money that cannot presently be called in and delay/repetition in procuring it, not final failure, retrogradation being a returning condition. Saturn lord of the 4th without material debilities except retrogradation and cadency shows the houses sound, their lord only delayed/cadent. Hence positive outcome, lowered terms, money in time, after delay.
summary: He shall buy the houses and procure the money in time, but only after months of delayed, difficult negotiation and an abatement from the seller's first price.
